implementation.definite_integer_conics: Complete exact integer projection bounds; shorter-axis enumeration; exact discriminant square/divisibility tests and original coefficient residual checks. Handles negative forms, common content, skinny mixed forms and huge translations within bounds.
implementation.shifted_bilinear: Use (b*x+e)*(b*y+d)=d*e-b*f. Remove common coefficient content, enumerate signed ordered factor pairs with both congruences, or return each integral affine family when the product vanishes. Verify each point/family in original coefficients.
implementation.original_solve_domains: Retain original equations through scalar/system dispatch, fallback, Float rationalization and output formatting. Reject proved undefined candidates; retain unknown domains. check=False keeps existing unfiltered behavior. All candidates share one checker allowance.
implementation.original_integer_domains: Admit retained structured sources before normalization; derive original axes from retained typed symbol nodes. Filter complete finite sets. Refuse unresolved/captured conditional families and unsupported inactive-axis/zero-polynomial parameterizations.
implementation.input_scope: Diophantine source admission accepts structured symbolic expressions and bounded integer/name tokens. Explicit syms must be a built-in list or tuple of distinct exact Symbol/Dummy coordinates. Compound expression strings and external conversion hooks are unsupported.
implementation.limits: No new Pell/general indefinite or general ternary algorithm; no portable proof-certificate or compatibility-profile claim; source preflight is not a new complete expansion-resource envelope. Existing general variable-assumption filtering and older non-definite/Pythagorean family semantics are unchanged.
